source_refs.note: Factors Affecting Image Quality: a main subheading of 20.2 Diagnostic Use of Ultrasound in Medical Imaging, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 159-159.

items: Acoustic impedance difference (farq): do tissues (maslan soft tissue aur haddi) ki impedance mein jitna zyada farq, echo utni strong aur boundary image mein utni saaf.

Ultrasound ki frequency: zyada frequency se resolution (barik cheezein alag alag dikhna) behtar hoti hai lekin penetration (andar jana) kam; kam frequency zyada gehrai tak jati hai lekin image kam saaf hoti hai.
Gel ka istemal: transducer aur skin ke darmiyan khaas gel lagaya jata hai taa ke air gaps (hawa ki khali jagahein) khatam hon aur sound waves achhi tarah andar jayein.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Ultrasound Doppler effect se, yani awaz ki frequency mein shift (tabdeeli) pakar kar, blood flow (khoon ke behne) ki speed bhi naap sakta hai.
